description: This week's top grossing and top free apps and games on the App Store and Google Play, from Horizontal's Top Apps: the world's (the charts of ten countries added up) and China's. The first ten of each list have an analysis: what the app does, the first principle behind its success and the core need it meets. With query, it finds analysed apps by name or by what they do instead, from any list.

chart.description: Which list: world-grossing-apps (World: top grossing apps), world-grossing-games (World: top grossing games), world-free-apps (World: top free apps), world-free-games (World: top free games), china-grossing-apps (China: top grossing apps), china-grossing-games (China: top grossing games), china-free-apps (China: top free apps), china-free-games (China: top free games).
